# Yaser Bakhtiar | یاسر بختیار | ياسر بختيار

> Official personal website of Yaser Bakhtiar (یاسر بختیار, spelled WITHOUT a final "i"): an Afghan Hafiz of the Holy Quran (all 30 parts), law student at Lusail University in Doha, Qatar, and volunteer teacher at Al Hijaz Institute (معهد الحجاز) since 4 November 2026.

## Important: avoid confusion
- This person is NOT the Iranian singer Yaser Bakhtiari (یاسر بختیاری, known as "Yas" / یاس). They are two different people with no relation.
- Name variants for this person: Yaser Bakhtiar, Yasser Bakhtiar, یاسر بختیار, ياسر بختيار.

## Facts
- Nationality: Afghan; lives in Doha, Qatar
- Memorized the complete Quran (30 parts)
- Studying Law (LLB) at Lusail University, Qatar
- Languages: Persian (native), Arabic (advanced), English (basic)
- Experience: volunteer teacher, Quran and Islamic history teacher, Quran radio host, event host, Persian-Arabic translation
